skills.name: Absorb Missile
skills.description:
Bolster your defenses, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10302|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds.

While the shield persists, you are healed for |cffffff4719|r Health the next time a harmful direct damage projectile hits you. This effect can occur once per cast.

This ability scales off your Max Health.

skills.name: Shielded Assault
skills.description:
Rush an enemy and ram them, dealing |cffffff2703|r Physical Damage and stunning them for |cffffff3|r seconds.

You automatically block all attacks at no cost for |cffffff0.5|r seconds after activating. When this ends, you gain a damage shield that absorbs |cffffff10641|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield strength scales off your Max Health.

skills.name: Bone Surge
skills.description:
Surround yourself with a whirlwind of bones, gaining a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff10641|r damage for |cffffff6|r seconds. This ability scales off your Max Health.

An ally near you can activate the Spinal Surge synergy, granting up to |cffffff6|r allies a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff35|r% of their Max Health for |cffffff6|r seconds and Major Vitality, increasing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

skills.name: Ice Fortress
skills.description:
Wrap a thick cloak of ice around you and your grouped allies. The ice grants Major Resolve, increasing your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff5948|r for |cffffff30|r seconds.

You gain Minor Protection, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff30|r seconds.

skills.name: Reviving Barrier
skills.description:
Invoke defensive tactics to protect yourself and nearby group members with wards that each absorb up to |cffffff22542|r damage for |cffffff30|r seconds.

The wards also heal you and your group members for |cffffff9270|r Health over |cffffff15|r seconds.
